prompt:
Write a first-person account (about 120 words) by the driver for an insurance claim form. Accident: rear-end collision in Baytown, Texas. Injury: back strain. No names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1166; do not mention it.) Work these facts into the text naturally, in your own words, without listing them:
- The claimant told the same account in every conversation.
- The driver is named on the policy.
text: I was stopped at a red light on a main road in Baytown, Texas, when the vehicle behind me struck the rear of my car. The impact was firm enough to push me forward against my seatbelt, and I felt a sharp pain in my lower back almost immediately. I exchanged information with the other driver at the scene and gave the same description of what happened to the officer, to the adjuster who called me, and to the medical staff who examined me afterward. I am the named driver on this policy and I was operating my own vehicle with the owner's permission at the time. Since the collision I have been treated for a back strain and have followed the recommended rest and physical therapy. I am providing this statement so the claim can be reviewed based on my account.
